chunks: Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, said:
I asked him about the dead person: when a human being touches him, is there ghusl (ritual bath) in that? He said: “If you touch his body when it has become cold, then perform ghusl (ritual bath).”
ai.seo_question: Does touching a dead body require ghusl (ritual bath) in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning touching the body of a deceased person. It indicates that if a person touches the corpse after the body has become cold, ghusl (ritual bath) becomes required.
